prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept. Remove ALL carvings, molding, banners, framed art, small hardware, ivy, plants, foreground clutter, excess stools, tiny masonry marks and grain, ornamental piano panels and busy patterned textiles. Use thick chair legs and big readable instrument bodies, greatly simplified piano keys, simplified large strings as a few readable strokes. Preserve believable grounded proportions, no toy-like or chibi exaggeration, no fantasy decoration. Beauty comes from broad light and color, calm clear shapes and airy depth. All SIX panels should look like practical Unity realtime 3D visual targets with low-to-medium detail broad mesh surfaces, no watercolor paper or pencil drawing overlays. No cartoon outlines, clay toy effects, photorealistic fine texture, dense patterns, UI, people, or logos. Exact title 'MUSIC ROOM / MOBILE VR CONCEPTS'. Each panel has only its number and the exact short label listed. Slim ivory gutters, large clear scenes. This is a serious restrained mobile-game environment concept sheet, genuinely much simpler and chunkier than the source.
